turns.response_markdown: Seasons change because Earth’s axis is tilted as it orbits the Sun, causing different parts of the planet to receive varying amounts of sunlight throughout the year. When a hemisphere tilts toward the Sun it experiences warmer seasons, and when it tilts away it experiences cooler seasons.
